mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, increasing the likelihood of a near-term economic slowdown and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 103.0, or the signal's predictive power is not significant (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 237.0 over a two-month window signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and increasing real interest rate expectations, which depress equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during CPIAUCSL spikes above 237.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to maintain a Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint improvement in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE fails to predict positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 439,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST), indicates robust consumer demand and a strong expansionary cycle, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a falling industrial production (INDPRO), signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
